templates.fn-hint: {name} is a parameter; to call it, give it a function type, as {name}: (x: int) => int

when.fn-hint: A call of a parameter written as a name with no function type and no default (f17-recursion.md 13.5). name is the parameter's name

templates.parameter-at-fn: {name} is a value; to pass it as a function, give it a function type

when.parameter-at-fn: A plain argument at an Fn parameter that is an identifier whose innermost binding is a parameter written as a name with no function type and no default (f17-recursion.md 13.5). name is the parameter's name

templates.higher-order: a function that takes a function cannot be passed to {name}

when.higher-order: A lambda argument that is a lambda with a parameter of a function type, or the name of such a const-bound lambda, of any call (f17-recursion.md 13.2 rule 8). name is the callee as written: the function, the method or the lambda the argument is given to
